description: This file contains functions related to upgrading firmware on Sony devices, including boot configuration updates, partition handling, flashing kernel and root filesystem, and backup procedures.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates boot configuration stored in specific MMC partition offsets for Sony devices.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs complete firmware upgrade process including flashing kernel, root filesystem, formatting rootfs_data, backup handling, and reboot.
